Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) analysis via lumbar puncture on August 27 demonstrated pleocytosis (97 cells/μL; 91% mononuclear), hypoglycorrhachia (glucose 2.99 mmol/L), and elevated protein (0.88 g/L).
